The SI unit of length is the meter (m).
The SI unit of mass is the kilogram (kg).
The SI unit of time is the second (s).
The SI unit of electric current is the ampere (A).
The SI unit of thermodynamic temperature is the kelvin (K).
Power is measured in watts (W); 1 W = 1 J/s.
Force is measured in newtons (N); 1 N = 1 kg·m/s².
